VVS diamonds are `high-quality stones with "Very Very Slightly Included" clarity` , meaning they contain microscopic imperfections that are extremely difficult for an expert to see even under 10x magnification.[[1]](https://www.frostnyc.com/blogs/news/how-much-are-vvs-diamonds)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/vvs-diamond-clarity/)

### What VVS Means

- **Definition:** VVS stands for Very Very Slightly Included. It sits just below Flawless (FL) and Internally Flawless (IF) on the [Gemological Institute of America (GIA)](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/vvs-diamond-versus-vs-diamond/) clarity scale.[[1]](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/vvs-diamond-versus-vs-diamond/)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/vvs-diamond-clarity/)
- **VVS1 vs. VVS2:** VVS1 has tinier inclusions that are usually only visible from the bottom (pavilion) of the diamond. VVS2 has slightly more noticeable microscopic marks under magnification, but both look identical to the naked eye.[[1]](https://stienhardt.com/blogs/education/vvs-vs-vs-diamonds/)
- **Appearance:** They are completely "eye-clean," meaning you cannot see any flaws without special jeweler tools.[[1]](https://www.bluenile.com/blog/diamonds-jewelry/vvs-diamonds)

### Price and Value

- **Cost:** Natural VVS diamonds typically cost anywhere from $2,500 to over $20,000 per carat depending on the cut, color, and size. For example, a 1-carat round natural diamond can cost around $2,900, while larger 1.5 to 2-carat stones range from $8,000 to $16,000+.[[1]](https://www.frostnyc.com/blogs/news/how-much-are-vvs-diamonds)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:18362952028060627781,catalogid:1049380984579178472,gpcid:18361121257979093057&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:5192691194190511250,catalogid:379594181971732782,gpcid:14183305763343560268&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:13703361398682845864,catalogid:3099631333728958899&ibp=oshop)
- **Lab-Grown Option:** Lab-grown VVS diamonds offer the exact same physical and visual quality for 30% to 50% less money.[[1]](https://www.frostnyc.com/blogs/news/how-much-are-vvs-diamonds)
- **Is it worth it?** Because lower grades like VS1 or VS2 are also completely clean to the naked eye, many buyers choose VS grades to save money on features they cannot see. VVS is best for people who value maximum rarity and perfection.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/6rCwnuQryew)[[2]](https://www.frostnyc.com/blogs/news/how-much-are-vvs-diamonds)

expanded_element.snippet: Diamond clarity is a measure of the purity and rarity of the stone, graded by the visibility of these characteristics under 10-power magnification. A stone is graded as flawless if, under 10-power magnification, no inclusions (internal flaws) and no blemishes (external imperfections) are visible.
